$comment: D-PP-EMBED-ANGLE (C23 6.10.4.1p8): the project manifest exists ONLY to declare `includes` -- the file-driven `-I` (docs/project-config-spec.md) -- because the angle form of `#embed` searches the angle `#include`'s places (the system directories, then the include directories) and never the including file's own directory. `res/blob.bin` is reachable through nothing else, so a build that resolved the angle form any other way could not produce this program. `includes` entries in a ROOT manifest resolve against the process working directory, which both examples runners make the staged example directory before a project build.
